views.title: Login with MFA
views.description: POST /api/v1/users/login, then /login/mfa when the role requires TOTP (ADR-032, CU84).
views.mermaid:
---
title: "Login with MFA"
---
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  actor notary as Notary
  participant notaire_frontend_edge_bff as API route handlers
  participant notaire_backend_security_mfaGate as MFA login gate
  participant notaire_backend_security_lockout as Login lockout
  participant notaire_backend_outbound_crypto_totpCipher as TOTP secret encryption
  notary->>notaire_frontend_edge_bff: POST /api/v1/users/login
  notaire_frontend_edge_bff->>notaire_backend_security_mfaGate: Credentials
  notaire_backend_security_mfaGate->>notaire_backend_security_lockout: Check lockout and password
  notaire_backend_security_lockout-->>notaire_backend_security_mfaGate: Password valid
  notaire_backend_security_mfaGate-->>notaire_frontend_edge_bff: MFA challenge (no session yet)
  notary->>notaire_frontend_edge_bff: POST /api/v1/users/login/mfa with the TOTP code
  notaire_frontend_edge_bff->>notaire_backend_security_mfaGate: Challenge + code
  notaire_backend_security_mfaGate->>notaire_backend_outbound_crypto_totpCipher: Decrypt secret, verify code
  notaire_backend_security_mfaGate-->>notaire_frontend_edge_bff: Set-Cookie: httpOnly JWT
  notaire_frontend_edge_bff-->>notary: Dashboard

findings.title: Ports speaking legacy web DTOs
findings.description: 40 files in 8 contexts import com.licensis.notaire.dto (testimony, procedure, management, history, concept, audit, registrationdraft, item). #2485; R2 does not guard it yet (#2484).

findings.title: Contexts without a domain model
findings.description: audit, budget, item, report, catalog, documentcosttemplate: ports carry view records and the rules sit in adapters. The report inbound port (GenerateReportsUseCase) is implemented by adapter.out.report.ReportService, a use case inside an outbound adapter. #2486.

findings.title: Legacy JPA model
findings.description: 36 @Entity classes (47 legacy model classes) and 36 Spring Data repositories still outside adapter.out.persistence. #2486.

findings.title: Legacy-package guards missing
findings.description: R6 only watches the already-empty jpa and service packages, and R2 does not forbid the legacy dto package in the application layer. #2484.

findings.title: protect-main ruleset
findings.description: Desired: PR-only merges, no deletion, no force-push, no required checks (the local preflight is the PR gate, #2001). Live: still requires the five retired product-CI checks. #2490.

findings.title: PDF reports → Inbound ports: Implements GenerateReportsUseCase (finding)
Reverse proxy → Actuator chain: Forwards every /actuator/* path to the internet-facing ingress
findings.description: Only /actuator/health is needed outside the private network. #2487.

findings.title: Reverse proxy → MFA login gate: Production compose and Kustomize omit the MFA key, policy and COOKIE_SECURE
findings.description: MFA enrolment fails and the JWT cookie lacks Secure in production. #2488.

findings.title: postgres (ClusterIP :5432)
findings.description: Data on emptyDir: lost on every pod restart. #2489.
